summary: Finalization cleanup is optional and has no guaranteed timing.

semantics.collection: implementation may never collect a target
semantics.cleanup: may be delayed indefinitely or never run
semantics.tests: must not require callback occurrence within a deadline

caveats: Do not translate this to deterministic Dispose/finalizer timing.

tests.name: no timing assertion
tests.input: const f=new FinalizationRegistry(()=>console.log('cleanup')); let x={}; f.register(x,1); x=null; console.log('sync')
tests.expected_behavior: prints sync; cleanup presence/timing is intentionally unspecified

tests.name: live target prevents eligibility
tests.input: const f=new FinalizationRegistry(()=>{}); const x={}; f.register(x,1); console.log(typeof x)
